seed_policy.rationale: The brief requires paired games on already-spent seeds. Reusing a seed that has dozens of prior games costs zero new evidence and cannot inflate the result the way a fresh seed could. Every seed below has >=22 prior saved games and has already faced V56.
seed_policy.explicitly_not_used: 93000-93011 are consumed by the V92 holdout and are excluded entirely.
seed_policy.verification: counts taken from experiments/**/games.jsonl (6302 game records, 716 distinct seeds) before this plan was frozen

seats: both ab and ba for every pairing

predeclared_gate.1_zero_errors: candidate_errors + opponent_errors + infrastructure_errors + timeouts == 0 across every run in both arms and the control
predeclared_gate.2_action_diff_fires: count of turns where V93's submitted market list differs from V92's must be > 0, and every difference must be confined to WOOL SELL quantity. A run where the overlay never fires is an INVALID test, not a win.
predeclared_gate.3_arm_A_no_regression_vs_incumbent: vs V92: wins+draws >= losses, and median paired coin margin >= 0
predeclared_gate.4_arm_B_no_score_rate_regression_vs_v56: V93 score rate vs V56 within 5 percentage points of the matched frozen V92-vs-V56 control score rate on the same seeds in the same seats, and median paired coin margin vs V56 not negative by more than 5% of the control median margin
predeclared_gate.5_honest_sizing: report effect with confidence interval and raw per-game numbers; if the interval straddles zero the result is reported INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass
predeclared_gate.on_pass: report to root reviewer with artifact paths and hashes; root decides any Kaggle submission
predeclared_gate.on_fail: NO-GO. no retune, no rerun on different seeds, no submission.
